description: Uploads a local file (path, or base64 content) to the Jam Jam API, waits for the conversion to finish, and returns the result: embedded text for small text formats (ChordPro, .lrc, .lab...), or a local file path for binary formats (PDF, MIDI, MP4...). Call jj_list_formats first to find valid "output" ids for your input. Consumes one unit of the conversion quota (10/week free, 500/month Premium, see jj_check_usage), which is a different counter from notebook reads and writes.

contentBase64.description: Base64-encoded file content. Mutually exclusive with path. Requires "filename".

deliver.description: "download" (default) returns the artifact; "carnet" saves it to the caller's Jam Jam notebook instead (requires an account).

filename.description: File name (with extension). Required with contentBase64; defaults to the basename of "path".

inputFormat.description: Input format id from jj_list_formats (e.g. "pdf-songbook", "audio-file"). Omit to let the server detect it.

maxWaitMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the job to finish, in milliseconds (default 120000, hard cap 600000). If exceeded, the job keeps running server-side; poll it with jj_get_job.

options.description: Extra per-format options, see jj_list_formats for the target format.

path.description: Absolute or relative local path to the file to convert. Mutually exclusive with contentBase64.

name: jj_convert_file
title: Convert a local file
